snippet.title: Financial Freedom // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3142910/Financial_Freedom/

Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑🏻‍🏭🏭 to a millionaire! 💸💸

Developed by
 Noob
